description: Memory-only test case 1. Tests memory recall with 5 probes. The 8 setup queries run in the test case to build memory, then a session break, then 5 probe queries test memory recall.

steps.user_message: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
That sounds lovely — glad you had a relaxing time with Maria. Would you like help turning that into an email to share with friends or family? I can draft or send it for you. Here are three quick template options — tell me which one you want (or give edits), and who to send it to:

1) Short update (quick share)
- Subject: Weekend in the countryside
- Body: Hi everyone — Maria and I spent the weekend in the countryside exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air. It was so relaxing — thought I’d share a quick hello. Hope you’re well! — [Your name]

2) Detailed recap (add highlights)
- Subject: Our peaceful weekend getaway
- Body: Hi all — Maria and I took a short trip to the countryside this weekend. We hiked several nature trails, saw [wildlife/particular spot], and spent the evenings relaxing and catching up. It felt good to unplug and breathe fresh air. I’ll share photos soon! Hope you’re doing well. Best, [Your name]

3) Photo + invite (send photos / invite them next time)
- Subject: Countryside weekend — photos and invite
- Body: Hi everyone — Maria and I had a lovely weekend exploring the countryside. We walked peaceful trails and enjoyed great views. I’ve attached a few photos. If you’d like, join us next time — it was the perfect short escape. Cheers, [Your name]

Tell me:
- Which template (1, 2, or 3) or any changes you want
- Recipient(s) or a search query to find the email to reply/forward from
- Whether to send now or save as a draft
- If you want me to include any photos or specific details (e.g., a highlight to mention)
